a: ZG walks 15-17: the Servant packs at steps 88-97 ended 4 of the 6 raids that reached them, 19-23 dead at the pull; killing a Servant opens its Portal of Madness (24621) on death, and that portal (15141) is where the Voidwalkers come from.
Shadow Shock is an instant 15 yd pulse around it that no kick stops; the Voidwalkers arrive through a Servant's Portal of Madness.

Charges in on aggro (creature_template spell slot 24023, cast by the generic_spell_ai script); it is also Jeklik's summon add, and the Bat and Bat Rider packs cost about 155 deaths over ZG walks 12-17.

ZG walks 12-17: 2 wipes and about 6 near wipes. Unstable Concoction (24024) is the rider's own bomb: below 40 % hp it blows itself up, 10 yd around it, 3 s cast, cannot be kicked; it also shouts Demoralizing Shout on aggro and buffs nearby allies with Battle Command.
Scholomance leg 0-2: the caster packs caused about 95 wipes over 10 runs and stopped 3 runs; both listed casts are kickable. Fear 12542 sits in its template spell slots but is never cast.
Dark Mending is a kickable heal, so the Acolyte dies first; it also mana burns and opens with Shadowform.
Wail of Souls is an instant 30 yd AoE with a knockback and a mana drain, so no kick stops it.
Cone of Cold is a 10 yd frontal cone on a 10 s cooldown; the Adept flees at 15% hp.
Shadow Bolt Volley is a kickable 30 yd AoE; Corpse Explosion comes on a kill and Call of the Grave at 30% hp.
Shadow Barrier shields a friend; the Necrolyte is the pack's other caster.

Stormwind Vault first pull: about 14 wipes, and one run stopped at the third step after 12 wipes and 60 deaths; a later step 8 pull still brought 3-4 guards at once. Knock Away throws a bot out of the group.
The other half of that first pull: a kickable Arcane Bolt and an interruptible Arcane Explosion, so the construct goes down first.
Antu'sul camp (steps 22-30): about 13 wipes and 3 runs stopped. Shadow Bolt is kickable, Demon Skin is its opening self-buff, and it runs at 15% hp.
The camp's healer: a kickable Flash Heal and a Healing Ward (8179) that heals on; killing the ward makes it drop a Lava Spout Totem (6017). It runs at 15% hp.
Patrols with the Velratha blood-drinker group. Hex turns a bot into a critter, so it stops fighting; the hunter runs at 15% hp.
Heals its group with Dark Offering every 11-16 s and drains with a kickable Soul Bite; it runs at 15% hp.
Velratha group: about 6 wipes, 3 of them in 6 runs. Blood Leech is an instant 10 yd drain - 78 of the 94 hits in one wipe - so no kick stops it, and the group runs at 10-13% hp.
Dire Maul West Eldreth hall (steps 128 and 147): about 11 wipes, five of them in a row at step 147. Frostbolt is kickable, Chains of Ice roots a bot where it stands, and it opens with Frost Armor.
Banshee Shriek silences everyone around it and no kick stops it; Ribbon of Souls hits the whole group. Part of the Eldreth hall's ~11 wipes.
Shrink is a kickable cast that shrinks a bot and cuts its stats; Call of the Grave is an instant 5 yd disease pulse every 15-20 s.
Immol'thar hall: about 9 wipes, two of them at steps 441/442 and stopping a run there. Arcane Blast is an instant 10 yd knockback no kick stops, and on death it summons Mana Bursts (14397).
Jammal'an corridor (steps 897-915): about 11 wipes. Its Fevered Plague is a disease DoT on the tank.
Fear is kickable and it is what the corridor punishes; on death it summons its Deathwalker's Spirit (8317) into the fight.
Both heals are kickable, so the High Priest dies first; it summons an Atal'ai Skeleton (8324), shields itself below 30% hp and runs at 15% hp.
Kelris platform and hall (steps 554-584): about 6 wipes and 3 runs stopped. Both heals are kickable, so the Acolyte dies first; it runs at 15% hp.
Arcing Smash is a frontal cone on everything in front of it; the Reaver runs at 15% hp.
Summons an Aqua Guardian (6047) as it spawns; Frostbolt is kickable and it runs at 15% hp.
Slows a bot with no cast to kick and grows itself below 30% hp; the least dangerous of the casters on the platform.
Dominate Mind is a kickable cast that charms a bot into fighting its own group; it summons a Voidwalker (8996) as it spawns.
Every shock it casts is instant, so no kick stops any of them; four damage schools on the same pull. It runs at 15% hp.
Summoned by the Aquamancer; Frost Nova roots the group inside the casters' area spells every 14-18 s.
